fuel_consumption.source_quote: No fuel consumption stated; company operates entirely under CPAs where fuel is purchased directly by major airline partners or reimbursed as pass-through.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging. Republic operates under CPAs with American, US Airways, Delta, and United where fuel is a pass-through cost. All treasury lock agreements from 2004-2005 (for aircraft purchase interest rate hedging) were fully settled by December 31, 2005.

warnings: Regional carrier operating under CPAs — fuel is pass-through; no fuel hedging program.
All treasury lock agreements (interest rate hedges for aircraft purchases) fully settled by December 31, 2005.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed: 141,159,425 (fiscal year ended December 31, 2005) from Item 7 operating statistics table. Average price per gallon: $1.98 in 2005 vs $1.38 in 2004.
